headline: TEX @ HOU matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TEX 3.87 at HOU 3.48, with a projected total of 7.36. The projected total fell -0.83, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. Batter research is strongest for Ezequiel Duran, Braden Shewmake, Yordan Alvarez, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Corey Seager, Sam Haggerty because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
